answer: Stop sybils with a crystal, a jade, and a walnut. Each identity grows one crystal in a lattice: the Nth crystal from one funder must interlock with every crystal below it, so N clones post about N squared in bond. A jade seal, carved by a quorum of witnesses and hashed to its owner's address, certifies each crystal and cannot be copied to a second face. Once per epoch a walnut draw cracks a sample of seals; a seal whose witnesses backed two faces shatters, and the lattice above it collapses with it. One honest agent risks one crystal; a clone factory pays N squared to hide one shell.
